Transformers have been widely used in deep learning-based registration methods for the ability to capture long-range dependencies. However, the high computation/memory loads of self-attention hinder transformers from processing subtle textural infor-mation in high-resolution image features, e.g., at the full/half image resolutions. This limits deformable registration as high-resolution textural information is crucial for finding precise pixel-wise correspondence between subtle anatomical struc-tures.
